title: From Conditional Formalization to an Axiom-Free Finite-Lattice Program: Reassessment and Continuation of a Multi-Phase Lean 4 Project Around the Yang-Mills Mass Gap (Version 47: The Exact Cluster Recurrence and the Finite Kotecky-Preiss Induction)
description: Stone 47 release of the axiom-free finite-lattice Lean 4 program (Mathlib v4.15.0, CI-verified: 62 Phase-3 source files, ~730 theorems, 0 axioms, 0 sorry). New in this version (stones 36-47): the exact finite polymer-gas representation; finite Ursell coefficients with permutation invariance; the Penrose identity and the tree-graph bound; the hard-core polymer bound and the exponential activity bound; uniform local geometry and doubled-walk counting; the concrete Kotecky-Preiss smallness hypothesis with the explicit threshold beta <= 1/40000; the multinomial as a theorem (no division in Nat); the EXACT cluster recurrence kpTreeCoeff_recurrence; the abstract finite KP induction (S_M(gamma) <= exp(a gamma), KP hypothesis consumed exactly once); and its specialization: for 0 <= beta <= 1/40000 every finite partial sum of the rooted cluster coefficients with the real polymer activity is uniformly bounded by exp(card gamma). Honest epistemic framing: NO convergence claim (Summable/tsum are future work), no log Z identification, no thermodynamic limit, no clustering, no mass gap. This is an exploratory formalization program, not progress establishing the Millennium Problem.
